title: [review] tx_queue.py:400: pop() does not signal TxReserv
description: pop() removes the front entry by calling self._entries.pop(0).data directly without signaling the entry's reservation. If a packet was pushed with return_reservation=True, callers awaiting reservation.wait() will hang indefinitely since set_result() is never called.
close_reason: Fixed: pop() now signals TxReservation.set_result(True) before returning data. Also fixed confirm_transmitted() and _remove_first() to signal reservations. All 84 tx_queue tests pass.
